newsitem.title: USA: Sunriver Corp says TradeWave discontinued.
newsitem.headline: Sunriver Corp says TradeWave discontinued.

text.p: SunRiver Corp on Thursday said it has discontinued the operations of its wholly-owned TradeWave Corp subsidiary.
The Company will maintain a small core of employees to support the TradeWave customer base until the discontinuation is completed.

"The Company has explored every alternative to a discontinuation of TradeWave, but at this time, we firmly believe this decision is in the best interests of the Company and its shareholders." said Len Mackenzie, chairman and chief executive officer of SunRiver.

The Company expects to take a one-time after-tax charge of approximately $6.6 million in the fourth quarter of 1996 covering all expected costs associated with the discontinuation of TradeWave, including all operating losses through the date of discontinuance, as well as related write-downs and write-offs.
